headline: Ministry of Finance Publishes Draft Regulations Detailing Reductions in Personal Income Tax and Corporate Income Tax
summary: The Ministry of Finance is drafting a decree with detailed rules for Resolution No. 43/2026/QH16, which reduces personal and corporate income tax for individuals and enterprises.
why: Income tax changes alter after-tax earnings for households and businesses and can shift the outlook for listed Vietnamese companies. Vietnam's stock market is the main channel for investors to gain exposure.
